name: Falklands and South Georgia

seo.title: Falklands and South Georgia by Antarctica21: 17 Days
seo.description: A round trip from Punta Arenas to the Falklands and five days at South Georgia: king penguins, Grytviken, Gold Harbour and Salisbury Plain. September and October.

tagline: Seventeen days for king penguins and the Falklands.
answer: Falklands (Malvinas) and South Georgia is Antarctica21's seventeen-day, sixteen-night sea voyage, round trip from Punta Arenas. It calls at Saunders, West Point and Port Stanley, spends five days at South Georgia from Elsehul to Salisbury Plain, and stops at Bleaker Island on the way back. It sails in September and October with up to 96 guests.
overview: A sub Antarctic voyage that does not go to the Antarctic continent. Five days at South Georgia make it the deepest South Georgia stay in the Antarctica21 programme.

itinerary.title: Punta Arenas, embarkation
itinerary.summary: Free time at Explorers House, afternoon transfer to the port, then the Strait of Magellan.

itinerary.title: At sea
itinerary.summary: Lectures begin on the way to the Falklands.

itinerary.title: Saunders Island and West Point Island
itinerary.summary: Rockhopper and gentoo penguins and nesting albatross; optional hike and tea at West Point.

itinerary.title: Port Stanley
itinerary.summary: Guided or self guided time among the town's memorials and museums.

itinerary.title: At sea
itinerary.summary: Presentations on South Georgia; whale and seabird watching.
itinerary.label: Days 5 to 6

itinerary.title: Elsehul Bay
itinerary.summary: Afternoon arrival, subject to conditions and government approval; possible evening Zodiac cruise.

itinerary.title: Grytviken and Fortuna Bay
itinerary.summary: Customs, the museum and Shackleton's grave, then king penguins at Fortuna Bay or Stromness and an optional Shackleton walk.

itinerary.title: Gold Harbour and Drygalski Fjord
itinerary.summary: King penguins, elephant seals and hanging glaciers; fjord cruise if the weather allows.

itinerary.title: St Andrews Bay and Ocean Harbour
itinerary.summary: Large king penguin colony, whaling remains and a shipwreck.

itinerary.title: Salisbury Plain
itinerary.summary: King penguins, weather permitting, then the route back toward the Falklands.

itinerary.title: Bleaker Island
itinerary.summary: Evening landing at a bird reserve.

itinerary.title: Punta Arenas, disembarkation
itinerary.summary: Group transfer to the town centre.

inclusions: Access to Explorers House in Punta Arenas
Guided shore excursions, lectures and onboard entertainment
Buffet breakfast and lunch, a la carte dinner, wine, beer, juice, soft drinks, coffee, tea, water and snacks
Loan of waterproof boots, contingency plan and the IAATO passenger fee
children: Sea voyages: minimum age 12, per Antarctica21's travel tips FAQ.
faqs: Does this voyage go to Antarctica?
No. It covers the Falklands and South Georgia, round trip from Punta Arenas.
How many days at South Georgia?
Five, from Elsehul Bay on Day 7 to Salisbury Plain on Day 11.

suits.line: Five days at South Georgia's largest colonies.
